title: Egg-shaped object descends in the Kilo area
summary: Mario Woods tells of Egg-shaped object descends in the Kilo area, about 1978 at Kilo area near Kilo 10, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Kilo area near Kilo 10, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I only saw one other thing in the kilo area and it was an object that looked like an egg that went straight to the ground

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran, says that around 1978 he was posted in a stretch of nuclear missile sites run from Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, near a site called Kilo 10. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the only other strange thing he saw there was an object shaped like an egg that dropped straight down to the ground. He mentions a fellow veteran, Mark Wade, as part of the story, which he tells as one more sign of unknown craft around nuclear weapons.
